title: Corner glass shelf 3-Tier 8-Inch Wall Mount | Foxtrot Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom corner storage with a wall mount corner glass shelf that adds three tiers of display and organization with thick tempered glass.

  • Coordinated look: Designed for the Foxtrot collection so you can build a matching Foxtrot set with other designer bath accessories.
  • Tempered glass: 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with beveled edges for safety and strength.
  • Solid brass hardware: Crafted from solid brass materials for enduring support.
  • Clean install: Concealed screw mounting hardware for a streamlined appearance.
  • Finish flexibility: Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes for statement bath accessories and designer bathroom hardware coordination.

Specs
Overall size: 8-Inch L x 8-Inch W x 15-Inch H
Glass thickness: 0.39 in
Mounting type: Wall mount
Assembly required: No
Weight capacity: 2 lb
Included items: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Foxtrot Collection Three Tier Corner Glass Shelf
_previous.description: Add space and organization to your bathroom with this simple, contemporary design 3-tier glass vanity corner shelf. Featuring tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware this shelving unit is crafted for durability, strength and style. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass collection of products, this subtle glass shelf unit is the perfect complement to your bathroom decor.
